### Steps to reproduce

I tried to make MRP but didn't manage to get consistent crash. Tried a combination of project settings and I think I manage to pin point what might have cause it. I think it's the V-Sync Mode set to _Disabled_, because after I set it back to _Enabled_ never get the crash anymore. Instead the editor freeze with no logs (when editing code with, Zed, external editor).
